## Lights

```{python}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis
h.compare_table([
    ("Sunrise Fade", "sunrise-fade.qmd", sunrise_fade.SunriseSettings,
     "Turns a light on before dawn, brightens it to sunrise, then turns it off."),
    ("Sunset Fade", "sunset-fade.qmd", sunset_fade.SunsetSettings,
     "Brightens a light as the sun sets, then turns it off at night."),
    ("Light Fade", "light-fade.qmd", light_fade.LightFadeSettings,
     "A fade with your own levels, start times and direction."),
])
```

Levels: sun elevation in degrees. See [Sun levels](sun-levels.qmd).

| Want | App |
|---|---|
| Wake up to light | [Sunrise Fade](sunrise-fade.qmd) |
| Light a room before dark | [Sunset Fade](sunset-fade.qmd) |
| Other levels, times or direction | [Light Fade](light-fade.qmd) |
| 1% too dark or 100% no brighter than 80% | [Light Calibration](light-calibration.qmd) |
